rules.title: Semantic HTML first
rules.text: Use native elements (button, a, nav, label) before ARIA; add ARIA only to fill gaps.

rules.title: Full keyboard support
rules.text: Every interactive control must be reachable and operable by keyboard with a visible focus indicator.

rules.title: Text alternatives
rules.text: Give meaningful images alt text and mark decorative images with empty alt.

rules.title: Color contrast
rules.text: Meet 4.5:1 contrast for text and 3:1 for UI components, and never rely on color alone.

rules.title: Labelled forms
rules.text: Associate every input with a label and expose errors in text linked with aria-describedby.

rules.title: Manage focus
rules.text: Move focus into dialogs and back on close, and keep a logical tab order.

rules.title: Announce dynamic changes
rules.text: Announce asynchronous updates with aria-live regions.

rules.title: Automated a11y checks
rules.text: Run automated accessibility checks (axe, Lighthouse) in tests or CI.

rules.title: Touch target size
rules.text: Keep touch targets at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels.
